label: run 5: resident 22844259, first 16384 bytes of the payload at 0x30000 at 115200, then baud trials
argv: run 5: resident 22844259, first 16384 bytes of the payload at 0x30000 at 115200, then baud trials

payload.kind: TMEM v1 dense5 container (docs/format.md) of the trits in the source file

source_sidecar.order: row-major rows of the unpacked [rows, cols] matrix (Hugging Face unpack order)

t0_note: every time is host seconds after the start on one monotonic clock

transfer.latency_note: per chunk: from the host's write of the transmission that was acknowledged to the ack line's arrival; chunk_s (per chunk) also counts the failed attempts before it
transfer.turnaround_note: per chunk sent once: ack time minus the host's write start minus the frame's own wire time (10 bits per byte at the port rate): device commit, the ack line (20 bytes), USB and host latency
